muck_muck.look: A builder in his late fifties: tall and stocky, brown hair, blue eyes. Drawn as the innkeep until art request A26 is made.

sinner.look: A cleric and healer: a woman with ginger hair and green eyes. Drawn as the hedge priest until art request A27 is made.

tenth_keeper._doc: D254: the keeper at the foot of the tenth floor's stair, which ends the Second Hour as the Warden of the Fifth ends the first. A stand-in look (the colossal titan's) until its own is drawn (docs/24, A36). **Inferred**: name, look and numbers.
